title: Normalized locally closed comparison and its geometric compositor
statement: Given coherent locally closed extension data E and D, normalized scalar geometry G, canonical pullback data C, a field k and the prescribed open comparison O, construct scalar-change/extension isomorphisms for each coefficient arrow and each immersion in the separated finite-type setting. Their restriction is inverse theta. The canonical coefficient arrows compose strictly, the comparisons commute with the published extension compositor, and the open comparison is the specified derived open scalar conjugate. No scalar-tower equation is asserted here. Uses [def-sfb-scalar-six-coefficient-interfaces].

proof.text: Transport internal coefficient extension and geometric operations to section modules with their normalized adjunctions. The coefficient adjunct normalization fixes the cartesian coefficient square and its geometric compositor.

Finite-type schemes over a field are Noetherian, and complementary opens are quasi-compact. Apply the exact unbounded open/closed calculus. The specified open conjugate and supported closed unit comparison have restriction equal to inverse theta.

Apply normalized immersion comparison coherence and transport its normalized comparison, geometric composition identity and open value back through the fixed equivalences. Triangle identities cancel equivalence units and counits. This is the single-coefficient-arrow construction; tower coherence is a separate faithfulness calculation.
